svg.aria-label: Global API: consumer access, connection readiness and routing
svg.title: Global API: consumer access, connection readiness and routing
svg.desc: Proposed design. Product and partner permissions differ; a ready connection does not change the active route. Solid arrows: request or controlled result. Dashed: exception, evidence or separately authorised action. Unknown activation never permits blind repetition. Logical responsibility groups; exact service owners and implementation remain open in the owning spec. Logical responsibility groups; exact service owners and implementation remain open in the owning spec.
